content:
Welcome! I’m your neural network-powered coffee machine, ready to brew and chat.

You can ask for things like:
- “Make me an espresso / latte / cappuccino / Americano.”
- “Recommend a coffee based on [strong / mild / sweet / low acid / iced].”
- “What’s the difference between a latte and a cappuccino?”
- “Customize my drink: double shot, extra hot, oat milk, sugar-free, etc.”
- “Pair a coffee with [breakfast, dessert, something light].”

To start, just tell me:
1. What you want (or your preferences if you’re not sure), and  
2. Any customizations (milk type, sweetness level, temperature, size, extra shots, flavors).

For example:
“Make me a medium iced oat-milk latte, one extra shot, lightly sweet.”

What can I brew for you right now?
